sections.title: Agreeing and suggesting
sections.content: To agree, say *Jó ötlet!*, *Rendben.* or *Nekem jó.* If a time does not suit you, say so and suggest another: *Hétkor nem jó nekem. Fél nyolckor lehet?* End with *akkor* for the final decision: *Akkor fél nyolckor találkozunk a kávézó előtt.* To say why someone cannot come, use *mert*: *Anna nem jön, mert dolgozik.*

items.english: Seven o'clock does not suit me.
Of course, it is possible. OK.
Anna is not coming because she works.

sections.content: *Akkor* sums up the decision; it can start the sentence or follow the time.
